name: Schweiter Technologies AG
summary: Schweiter Technologies AG, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and commercializes composite materials and solutions in lightweight construction in Europe, the Americas, the Asia Pacific, and Africa. The company offers extruded and cast plastic and lightweight panels, aluminum composite panels and materials, cast and extruded synthetic sheets, lightweight foam-boards, and core materials based on balsa wood and PET foam. Its products are used in the visual communication and display, architecture, wind energy, industry, shipbuilding, railway and bus construction, and industrial markets.
